invariants.description: kcf follows the Tao 2011 steady state (Suppl. Eq. 104) from kcf(0) = 0: kcf = kcf_bar(Vm) (1 - exp(-t/tau_kcf)), using the module's own tau_kcf
tau_kcf equals Tao 2011 Suppl. Eq. 105 (ms) converted to seconds
kcs follows the Tao 2011 steady state (Suppl. Eq. 106) from kcs(0) = 0: kcs = kcs_bar(Vm) (1 - exp(-t/tau_kcs)), using the module's own tau_kcs
tau_kcs equals Tao 2011 Suppl. Eq. 107 (ms) converted to seconds
i_KCa = g_kcf*kcf*(Vm - E_K) + g_kcs*kcs*(Vm - E_K) (Tao 2011 Suppl.; the module's encoded form)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(i_KCa - (g_kcf*kcf*(Vm - E_K) + g_kcs*kcs*(Vm - E_K)))) <= 1e-9*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(g_kcf*kcf*(Vm - E_K) + g_kcs*kcs*(Vm - E_K))))

bc_sweep.rationale: clamp potential -90 to +30 mV (rest to action-potential peak of a sympathetic neuron); reversal potential +/-20 mV about the Tao value; conductances by 0.5-2.

baseline.reason: candidates: the voltage-clamp steady-state and time-constant data of Belluzzi & Sacchi (J Physiol 1985 358:91 I_A; 1986 380:275 I_Na; 1988 397:127 I_KV; 1989 412:493 I_Ca; 1990 422:561 I_KCa), e.g. tau_hc 17.6-29.3 ms; set up after the unit/sign fixes.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: kinetic constants are hard-coded in the CellML; only the maximal conductance is a parameter.
